title: Annotation intake: write human annotation to SqliteLibrary (Rust binary, M1 near-term path)
description: Implements DESIGN.md section 9.4 near-term annotation capture for M1. Per sub-decisions (#13): M1 uses a Rust binary subcommand. Python CLI wrapper deferred to M2+. Binary subcommand: alcanzai annotate --library path.db --object KnowledgeObjectId 'annotation text'. Creates a new KnowledgeObject with content_type annotation, ingests via Library::ingest, stores relationship to target in the relationships table. Integration test: seed a KnowledgeObject, annotate it, rebuild vault, delete vault, rebuild again — annotation note appears both times (never vault-native). Acceptance criterion: alcanzai annotate command works; annotation note projected into vault; delete+rebuild test passes.
